subject: general
question: ‘The Unblemished One’, a dance film by ________, has won two awards at the White Unicorn International Film Festival (WUIFF) in the categories of ‘Experimental Film’ and ‘Film on Women.’
solution:
The correct answer is __**Anjana Ghonasgi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Unblemished One - a dance film by **Anjana Ghonasgi** for Narthaki.com’s Devi Diaries 2021 has won 2 awards at the White Unicorn International Film Festival (WUIFF) in the categories of ‘Experimental Film’ & ‘Film on Women.’
 
• **WUIFF **is a film festival held in the heart of Kolkata, the City of Joy. It celebrates films from all around the world with awards in different categories and genres. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Chitra Visweswaran** is an Indian Bharata Natyam dancer. She was awarded the Padma Shri in 1992.
 
• **Deepa Mehta** is an Indian-born Canadian **film director and screenwriter**. Mehta directed **Midnight's Children** after collaborating on the screenplay with the novel's author, **Salman Rushdie**.
 
• Oopali Operajita is a classical **Odissi **and **Bharatanatyam **dancer and choreographer.
